name: Ana Ningyou
source:
Main character's father adopts a female child. When father is away, protagonist insults his new sister-in-law and orders servants to train her as hole doll. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-may-2003-ashita-deatta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角的父亲收养了一个女孩。当父亲不在时，主角侮辱他的新嫂子，并命令仆人将她训练成洞娃娃。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-may-2003-ashita-deatta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
